assets.caption: APPENDIX 2 Typical Air Supply Plant with Single Header System
assets.notes: Full-page P&ID schematic showing air compressors, coolers, after coolers, water separators, air drier and after filter units (Appendix 3-6), buffer vessel, capacity control logic, instrument air header (Appendix 7), and associated instrumentation (PZA, PHC, QI, PG, FE, humidity). Legend shows open/closed valve symbols. Diesel emergency compressor and turbine-driven compressor also depicted.
